Name: Simple Bundle Difficulty
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]📦 Simple Bundle Difficulty[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#A7F3D0]PC and Android downloads · Single-player only[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#D8B4FE]Mod Requested By: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45]Harold45[/url][/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Choose how demanding the Community Center feels, from quicker completion to larger collection goals. Covers standard and remixed bundles, with an option to include the Missing Bundle.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎚 Choose Your Difficulty[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Very Easy (Quicker)[/b] — Any one listed entry; half quantities and Vault prices, rounded up.
[b]Easy (Quick)[/b] — Any one listed entry at the original quantities and prices.
[b]Standard[/b] — Up to two required entries at the original quantities and prices.
[b]Vanilla (Default)[/b] — Original bundle requirements.
[b]Hard[/b] — One extra required entry, capped at the available choices; quantities and Vault prices ×1.5, rounded up.
[b]Very Hard[/b] — Every listed entry; quantities and Vault prices ×2.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Item quality requirements, bundle rewards and normal unlock conditions follow the original bundle.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54059/54059-1792270871-1938726911.png[/img][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54059/54059-1792270876-1586231329.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]⚙ How to Use[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to choose a preset, include the Missing Bundle or pause adjustments on the current farm. Without GMCM, close the game and edit [b]config.json[/b].

Changes apply the next time you load your save. Bundles already started or completed keep their current requirements. Unsupported custom bundle definitions are skipped.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54059/54059-1792270880-1789896649.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]↩ Restore Before Removing[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]In GMCM, select [b]Restore unstarted bundles[/b], then [b]Save & Close[/b]. Review the in-game list and choose [b]Restore & Pause[/b]. Without GMCM, enter [b]sbd_restore[/b] in the SMAPI console to open the same confirmation.

[b]Save afterward, before removing the mod.[/b] Restoration affects only unstarted bundles and pauses adjustments for this farm. Started bundles remain modified; a pre-mod save backup is needed for a full rollback.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]To resume, uncheck [b]Pause this save[/b] and reload. Alternatively, use [b]sbd_resume[/b], save and reload. [b]sbd_info[/b] displays the current preset and pause status.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]📦 Requirements & Downloads[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]PC:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.x[/url].
[b]Android:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 and a compatible Android SMAPI port exposing API 4.3.2 or newer.
[b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu.

Download the edition for your platform and extract its folder into [b]Mods[/b]. Install only one edition. Multiplayer and split-screen are unsupported.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages & Previews[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian. AI assistance was used for code, text and translations.

Preview images are isolated native renders using the game’s artwork.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please post reports and ideas on this page. For bugs, include your mod/game/SMAPI versions and platform, expected versus actual behaviour, steps to reproduce and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. A screenshot or short video can help. For suggestions, explain what you would change and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
